page.overview:
Who is Blocker?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Blocker was individually carded as part of the Battle Force 2000 subset of G.I. Joe at the very end of 1987. In 1988 he was available carded in a special two-pack with Maverick and was discontinued the following year. ---- Appearance: black helmet with orange camouflage; black shirt with silver straps and orange armor on arms; black gloves; black pants with orange camouflage; orange and black boots

Accessories: silver XL-13 Light Refraction Submachine laser pistol with strap on back and handle on top.

Variations: Some Blockers came with an orange-tinted visor as part of the helmet. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/blocker.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/blocker.shtml Filecard]
